text: Area residents contacted my office and asked if additional on-street parking spaces could be accommodated on the east side of Bartlett Avenue, north of Bloor Street West. In response to this request, I asked Traffic Operations staff to look into whether this was possible. City staff have since reported back and informed me that additional parking spaces can be accommodated. The purpose of this motion is to have parking regulations on Bartlett Avenue amended in order to add additional parking spaces.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the parking regulations outlined in Appendix A attached to the Letter (July 4, 2018) from Councillor Ana Bailão. 2. Enacted the parking regulations outlined in Appendix B attached to the Letter (July 4, 2018) from Councillor Ana Bailão.
